use_threads.description: Whether to use multiple threads to query package lists. If false, adds the --no-threads flag.

shallow.description: If true, limits queries to one call per server. Adds the --shallow flag.

strict.description: If true, lists only packages that have exactly the specified name. Adds the --strict flag.

distros.description: List of distribution identifiers to query. Recognised values: archlinux, cygwin, debian, fedora, fink, freebsd, gentoo, mageia, mandriva, macports, netbsd, openbsd, opensuse, slackware, sourcemage, ubuntu. Adds the -d flag with comma-separated values.

package_name.description: The name of the package to query for in the repositories.
